title: Adding durations: 60 minutes make an hour
competencyName: Convert between hours, minutes and seconds
familyTitle: Adding durations and changing seconds into minutes and seconds
skill: Add two durations in hours and minutes, regrouping 60 minutes as 1 hour.

concept: A bigger unit is made of a fixed number of smaller units. When the small units reach that number, make one big unit from them and keep the rest as small units.
60 minutes make 1 hour, so when the minutes of a duration add up to 60 or more, 60 of them become 1 hour.
explanation.visualNote: Reuses the numberline visual (0–120 minutes, a mark at 60). A clock-face 'past the hour' visual exists (clock) but shows times, not durations.

workedExamples.prompt: A bus ride takes 4 h 45 min and a train ride after it takes 1 h 55 min. How long is the whole journey? Write the answer as (hours, minutes).

hints: Take 60 minutes out as 1 hour and add it to the hours.

alternativeExplanation.title: Like carrying, but at an hour
text: It works like carrying in addition, but you carry when the minutes make a whole hour, not when they make ten.

alternativeMethods.name: Change everything to minutes, then back
example: 4 h 45 min = 285 min; 1 h 55 min = 115 min; together 400 min

methodCredit: A correct final answer earns ANSWER credit only. Method credit needs a server-recorded verified working assessment. Checker status: none: no working contract (answer-level evidence only).
diagnosticRule: A single matching answer is a SUSPECTED error. misconception-evidence@1 establishes a misconception from two matching answers.

diagnostic.why: no-carry keeps 100+ minutes; regrouping at 100 instead of 60 (hour-as-100, unmodelled here) would give (h + 1, minutes − 100), a different answer, so the two beliefs are separated
diagnostic.prompt: A bus ride takes 4 h 50 min and a train ride after it takes 1 h 55 min. How long is the whole journey? Write the answer as (hours, minutes).

readings.reading: TARGET modelled error no-carry (conceptual): suspected on one answer

unexplained (no diagnosis; policy A: a single slip is kept, not acted on)

misconceptions.status: modelled (a single matching answer is a SUSPECTED error; established only under misconception-evidence@1: two matching answers)
misconceptions.note: the minutes are not regrouped into hours

whatWentWrong: In "A bus ride takes 4 h 40 min and a train ride after it takes 4 h 35 min. How long is the whole journey? Write the answer as (hours, minutes).", one wrong answer is (8, 75).
The minutes came to 75, but 60 of them make one hour.
60 minutes always make 1 hour, so the minutes part of a duration stays below 60.
screens.counterCheck: Check in minutes: 280 + 275 = 555 minutes = 9 × 60 + 15, so 9 h 15 min. An answer with 75 minutes still holds a whole hour inside the minutes.
